correctness.rationale: The four-cell partition of the (n-2)-clique determines every distance and every Szeged edge contribution. Reconstructing the clique-edge baseline and the three outside-vertex adjacency regimes gives the displayed polynomials. The exact 2-connectivity constraints reduce eta(G)=2n to elementary nonnegative-integer equations, yielding only the Zhang--Li family for all n>=10 and the one additional n=10 type. The finite verifier is corroborative only; the symbolic case analysis supplies the proof.
